decisions.decision: Remove the dead web adapters RBI, NSE, BSE entirely. Lookup = NSDL (live) + india-isin-data snapshot (offline seed).
decisions.resolution: Removal executed on backend-design-upgrade @ 54d0a6b0; local tier 717 passed / 0 failed; src+tests sweep shows zero dead-source references outside design docs.

decisions.decision: The final core website list (12 sites) is fixed as the reference stack for backend source planning: NSDL, CDSL, BSE, NSE, RBI, SEBI, CRISIL, ICRA, CARE, Acuite, India Ratings, SEBI-SMARTODR. Scraping feasibility is tracked separately per site; the list itself is the canonical core, not filtered by reachability.

NSDL, BSE, NSE and the credit rating agencies are EXISTENTIAL sources - the product is waste without them. All 12 core sites (D2) are targeted for data collection: browser-fingerprint-compatible clients, cookie warm-up, polite rates, public data only. Boundary: no auth bypass, no login-wall circumvention, no high-frequency hammering - collection, not hacking (developer framing 2026-11-25).

DOWNLOAD-FIRST policy: prefer official download paths (bulk files, public JSON APIs, RSS feeds) over scraping for all 12 core sites; respect each site's policy (robots.txt, terms). WAF-circumvention scraping is HELD — not implemented; scrape-only sites stay listed separately pending explicit developer authorization per site. agy worker is a STANDING research lane (never auto-closed, developer order 2026-11-25; overrides Q6 auto-close for this worker); PM runs the second parallel lane; both collect independently and report to t1w4.

findings.topic: T2 inputs — scraping stack research for all 12 core sites
findings.summary: Two parallel research streams. PM stream: backend/docs/research/pm_scraping_research_20261125.json — per-site feasibility + technique, library comparison (curl_cffi for WAF sites RBI/BSE/NSE, plain httpx for NSDL/agencies, playwright last resort), prior art (jugaad-data, nsepython, nsetools, cloudscraper), framework = existing Adapter protocol + pluggable transports + cookie-priming SessionManager. agy stream: separate agent writing backend/docs/research/agy_scraping_research_20261125.json (report contract: hc send t1w4).
findings.key_call: RBI 418 and BSE 403 are TLS-fingerprint/WAF rejections; curl_cffi impersonation is the known fix; BSE needs the cookie-priming wiring our code already half-has (COOKIE_PRIME_URL).

findings.topic: T3 contract inputs — primary data resources behind GoldenPi, IndiaBonds, Grip Invest
findings.summary: All three user brokers share the same primary stack: SEBI OBPP framework (CIR 2024/54), BSE+NSE debt segments (membership: GP 6809/90331, IB 6811/90316, Grip 90319), NSDL depository (IB DP IN305103, Grip DP IN304877), SEBI-registered rating agencies (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/Acuite/India Ratings), RBI for G-sec/FD. Detail: backend/docs/broker_data_sources_research_20261125.json.
findings.relevance: Our NSDL adapter already mirrors the brokers' primary resource; rating rationales are the next candidate official-facts source. Exchange public feeds block non-members — not viable adapters.

Live test 2026-11-25: NSDL WORKING (HTTP 200, facts returned on 3 sample ISINs); RBI NOT FUNCTIONING (HTTP 418 blocked); NSE NOT FUNCTIONING (HTTP 404, DEBT_SECURITY_MASTER.csv gone); BSE NOT FUNCTIONING (HTTP 403 even with browser headers, cookie priming never wired into http_get).
findings.evidence: probe script /tmp/adapter_probe.py, raw HTTP status check 2026-11-25

findings.topic: T2 — community handling recipe extracted from nsepython 2.101 source
findings.summary: Full working recipe for Akamai-protected sites: curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 -> warm-up GET / then /option-chain (harvests nsit/_abck/ak_bmsc/bm_sv cookies) -> API calls with Accept+Referer headers -> re-warm+retry on 401/403/404/429/503 -> endpoint fallback rewriting -> Playwright cookie harvest as last resort -> descriptive errors never silent empties. Detail: backend/docs/research/nse_recipe_extraction_20261125.json.
findings.relevance: Transfers directly: NSE all steps; BSE via www.bseindia.com priming (our unwired COOKIE_PRIME_URL); RBI via fingerprint impersonation; agencies plain.

findings.topic: T2 — merged scraping research (PM stream F3/F4 + agy stream)
findings.summary: Both streams agree; agy adds live-verified official endpoints: NSDL bulk ISIN CSV (securities_isin_code id-listing -> ISIN_DETAILS_18-Nov-2026.csv, HTTP 200 — fresher than our 11-Nov snapshot), RBI 3 RSS feeds (200 XML, no scraping needed), SEBI RSS (200), CRISIL AEM JSON servlet rating_sme_listing_service.json (200, metadata: companyCode/ratingDate/ratingFileName) + direct RatingDocs rationale HTML (200, 93KB), CDSL popup-isin.aspx, Acuite connect.acuite.in/liveratings, ICRA ShowRationaleReport. NSE/BSE confirmed impersonation-required. SCORES/SmartODR: DO_NOT_SCRAPE (authenticated PII) — matches D3 boundary. CRISIL robots.txt disallows specific bot UAs (Scrapy/GPTBot etc.) - keep identified custom UA + polite rates.
findings.relevance: Recommended stack (merged): stdlib/httpx for NSDL+RSS+bulk CSV; curl_cffi chrome-impersonation for RBI/BSE/NSE; lxml/bs4 for rationale HTML; Playwright only for offline SPA discovery (India Ratings); nsepython 7-step recipe (F4) as the handling blueprint. Files: research/pm_scraping_research_20261125.json + research/agy_scraping_research_20261125.json + research/nse_recipe_extraction_20261125.json.

findings.topic: T2 — download endpoints cross-verified by PM stream
findings.summary: Independent re-verification (identified UA, polite GETs): NSDL bulk discovery 200 (JSON file listing), CRISIL rating_sme_listing_service.json 200 (live docs: companyCode/ratingDate/heading), RBI pressreleases_rss.xml 200 XML, SEBI sebirss.xml 200 XML. Matches agy findings; download-first is viable for ISIN master + ratings metadata + regulator feeds without any scraping.
findings.relevance: Exists D2 existential coverage without scraping except NSE/BSE instrument masters, which remain HELD per D4.

findings.topic: T2 — deep data-quality proof beyond HTTP 200 (PM stream)
findings.summary: NSDL official bulk CSV PROVEN: discovery field 'f' -> /nsdl/2026-11/ISIN_DETAILS_18-Nov-2026.csv, 200, 264,221 rows (186,123 corporate INE), columns ISIN/NAME_OF_ISSUER/SECURITY_DESCRIPTION/CURRENCY/INTEREST_RATE/MATURITY_DATE/FISN/CFI — 5.6x our bundled snapshot, replaces it as master. BSE debt master PROVEN: ListofScripData segment=Debentures and Bonds WITH Referer+Origin headers (complete param set) -> 200, 5,475 active debt scrips with ISIN_NUMBER/FACE_VALUE/Issuer_Name/SCRIP_CD — no scraping needed, full browser headers only (D1's 403 was incomplete params/headers). CRISIL proven at depth: 200 docs/page incl. large corporates (Tata International, Nov 24 2026), fields companyCode/companyName/industryName/ratingDate/heading/ratingFileName.
findings.limitations: NSDL CSV lacks rating/payout_cycle/face_value/listing_status (covered by CRISIL+BSE instead). BSE returns Active only. CRISIL covers CRISIL-rated bonds only; rationale body needs per-doc HTML fetch. NSE remains the only site without a download-first path (held per D4).

findings.topic: ISM (ISIN master) collection — NSE cracked via official API; trifecta complete
findings.summary: NSE IS SOLVED without bypass: /api/daily-reports answers 200 on plain stdlib (param key={CM|SLBS|CD|CBM|FO|NBF|INDEX|WDM}) and returns official file URLs on the correct archives domain nsearchives.nseindia.IN (the earlier 404 was the wrong .com host). key=WDM lists WDM-SEC-AVAILABLE-FOR-TRADE -> wdmlist_23112026.csv (HTTP 200, 1.24 MB, 10,624 securities, 3,695 corporate INE) with SECTYPE/SECURITY/ISSUE_NAME(coupon)/ISSUE_DESC/ISSUE_DATE/MAT_DATE/Last IP Dt/Next IP Dt/Cpn Freq(payout cycle)/Last Traded/ISIN NO./STATUS. ISIN-master trifecta: NSDL bulk CSV 264,221 rows + BSE debt 5,475 + NSE WDM 10,624 - all plain polite GETs.
findings.relevance: All three ISM sources download-first verified; NSE leaves the HELD list; WDM file adds Cpn Freq + Next IPDt which NSDL CSV lacks - direct feed for the payment ledger.

findings.topic: ISM/download-first — merged final channel map (PM + agy lanes combined)
findings.summary: agy inventory: 59 channels (43 DOWNLOAD / 10 LIGHT / 6 SCRAPE-ONLY). New gold: NSDL 10 bulk XLS/XLSX debt datasets (28.8MB: Debt Instruments, Redeemed, CP, CD, Preference, Securitised, Defaulted) at nsdl.com/resources/data/detailed-list-debt-instruments; India Ratings UNAUTHENTICATED JSON APIs (home/GetSearch, home/GetIssuerPressReleases, pressReleases/GetPressreleaseData with ISIN annexures — SPA problem solved); CARE unauthenticated JSON (getSearchprintrating, getSearchrrddata) + direct PDFs without OTP; CRISIL Solr cmd=DR searchable BY ISIN; ICRA direct rationale PDFs (GetRationalReportFilePdf); Acuite 39,267-URL sitemap; CDSL PreferenceShares_data.xlsx + securitised_debt_instruments.xlsx + CorpBondDatabase.aspx; RBI 7 RSS; BSE notices/announcements RSS + OBP_MEMBER_LIST.zip.
findings.reconciliation: Two agy classifications corrected by PM live proofs: NSE is NOT scrape-only (F8: daily-reports API 200 + wdmlist CSV 10,624 rows verified); BSE ListofScripData is NOT held (F7: 200 with Referer/Origin + complete params, 5,475 debt scrips verified twice). True SCRAPE-ONLY remainder for bond data: NONE. DBIE SPA superseded by RBI RSS; NSDL BondInfo SPA superseded by nsdl.com bulk; SCORES/SmartODR out of scope per D3/D4.
findings.relevance: FINAL: all 12 sites served download-first; zero scraping required for the full existential stack (ISIN master + ratings + regulator feeds).
